title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A2–B1）
section: 第 1,951–2,000 個單字（CEFR A2 初級）

examples.en: I look forward to visiting Kenting National Park this summer vacation.
examples.zh: 我十分期待今年暑假能去墾丁國家公園遊玩。

examples.en: We look forward to hearing your constructive thoughts during tomorrow's team presentation.
examples.zh: 我們由衷期盼在明天的專案成果簡報中，能聆聽到您寶貴的建設性看法。

examples.en: Children always eagerly look forward to opening lucky red envelopes on New Year's Eve.
examples.zh: 小朋友們總是在除夕夜圍爐時，無比熱切盼望著親手打開喜氣洋洋的壓歲錢紅包。

examples.en: Neighbors took care of our plants while we traveled abroad.
examples.zh: 我們出國旅遊期間，鄰居熱心幫忙照料陽台花草。

examples.en: Don't worry about tonight's dinner; I will take care of cooking and washing up.
examples.zh: 今晚的晚餐你完全不用操心，買菜下廚與飯後洗碗收拾全包在我身上。

examples.en: Drink plenty of warm water and take good care of your health during chilly weather.
examples.zh: 氣溫驟降寒流來襲時，請務必隨時多補充溫開水，悉心照料保養好自己的身體健康。

examples.en: Never give up on your dreams, no matter how tough the path.
examples.zh: 無論道路多麼艱難，永遠不要放棄自己的夢想。

examples.en: He decided to give up sugary afternoon milk teas to improve his fitness and energy.
examples.zh: 他下定決心徹底戒掉下午茶常喝的高糖手搖奶茶，以改善個人體態與精神活力。

examples.en: Even when trailing by ten points, the basketball team refused to give up and fought on.
examples.zh: 即便在比數落後多達十分的劣勢下，籃球校隊全員依然堅決不放棄，奮戰至最後一秒。

examples.en: Don't put off until tomorrow what you can accomplish today.
examples.zh: 今日事今日畢，切勿拖延至明日。

examples.en: We had to put off our camping trip until next weekend because of the approaching typhoon.
examples.zh: 由於颱風暴風圈即將逼近，我們不得不將露營計畫順延至下個週末再行成行。

examples.en: Procrastinators often put off writing lengthy research reports until the final evening.
examples.zh: 有拖延習慣的人往往總是把篇幅冗長的研究報告拖延到最後交件前夕才挑燈夜戰。

examples.en: Scientists carried out field research on endemic tree frogs.
examples.zh: 科學家對本土特有種樹蛙進行了實地田野調查。

examples.en: The hospital medical staff carried out emergency surgery smoothly and saved the patient.
examples.zh: 醫院全體醫護團隊緊密配合，順暢執行了緊急搶救手術，成功化解病患危機。

examples.en: Soldiers are trained to carry out rescue orders with absolute precision during natural disasters.
examples.zh: 國軍官兵受過扎實嚴格訓練，能在各類天然災害肆虐時極其精準地貫徹搜救命令。

examples.en: We ran out of printer paper right before the class report.
examples.zh: 就在課堂報告前夕，我們的印表機紙張剛好用完了。

examples.en: Stop at the next highway service station before your car runs out of gasoline.
examples.zh: 在愛車的汽油徹底耗盡見底之前，趕緊在下一個高速公路服務區進站加油吧。

examples.en: The bakery ran out of fresh egg tarts within thirty minutes of opening its doors.
examples.zh: 這家名店烘焙坊早晨開門營業不到三十分鐘，剛出爐的現烤蛋塔就已全數被搶購一空。

examples.en: She gets along with all her roommates in the university dormitory.
examples.zh: 她與大學宿舍裡的所有室友都相處得十分融洽。

examples.en: Good active listening skills make it effortless to get along with diverse colleagues.
examples.zh: 擁有良好的傾聽與溝通同理心，能讓你在職場上與形形色色的同仁皆相處極為融洽。

examples.en: The new golden retriever puppy gets along wonderfully with the household cat.
examples.zh: 家中剛領養的黃金獵犬小幼犬，與原本傲嬌的家貓處得非常合拍、形影不離。

examples.en: The team came up with a brilliant idea for the science fair.
examples.zh: 團隊為科展想出了一個絕妙的創意點子。

examples.en: Can you come up with a creative solution to reduce warehouse packing waste?
examples.zh: 你能想出一個既環保又有創意的巧思方案，用以減少物流倉庫的包裝耗材浪費嗎？

examples.en: After hours of intense brainstorming, the marketing designers came up with an iconic logo.
examples.zh: 歷經長達數小時的腦力激盪，行銷設計團隊終於發想提出了一款極具代表性的標誌。

examples.en: Please turn down the TV volume while the baby is sleeping.
examples.zh: 小寶寶在睡覺，請把電視音量調小聲一點。

examples.en: She politely turned down the overseas job offer because she wanted to stay near her parents.
examples.zh: 為了能常伴在年邁父母身旁盡孝，她極其婉轉客氣地婉拒了海外跨國企業的優渥邀約。

examples.en: Don't forget to turn down the stove gas burner once the hearty broth reaches a boil.
examples.zh: 當鍋內濃郁的高湯煮沸翻滾之後，切記隨手將瓦斯爐火轉為小火慢燉細煲。

examples.en: I finally figured out how to solve this tricky algebra equation.
examples.zh: 我終於弄清楚如何解出這道棘手的代數方程式了。

examples.en: It took the software engineers two sleepless days to figure out what caused the server crash.
examples.zh: 軟體研發團隊廢寢忘食鏖戰了整整兩天，才終於徹底查明弄清伺服器當機的根本原因。

examples.en: Let's sit down with the travel itinerary and figure out the most cost-effective train route.
examples.zh: 咱們不妨拿出旅遊行程表坐下來好好核算一下，理出最省錢也最快捷的鐵道路線。

examples.en: All team members showed up on time for the morning rehearsal.
examples.zh: 全體隊員均準時抵達參加早晨的排練。

examples.en: We waited for forty minutes at the cafe, but our study partner failed to show up.
examples.zh: 我們在咖啡館裡苦等了整整四十分鐘，然而那位說好要一起讀書的夥伴卻始終未曾露面。

examples.en: Over ten thousand passionate baseball fans showed up at the stadium to cheer on the team.
examples.zh: 超過一萬多名狂熱熱情的棒球迷湧入大巨蛋棒球場，現場為心愛的球隊吶喊助威。

examples.en: Our scooter broke down on the mountain road, so we called for towing.
examples.zh: 我們的機車在山路上拋錨故障，於是打了通電話叫拖吊。

examples.en: The office color photocopier always seems to break down right before important deadlines.
examples.zh: 辦公室那台彩色影印機，總是挑在即將交件的緊要關頭莫名其妙地卡紙故障罷工。

examples.en: Exhausted from months of relentless stress, she finally broke down in tears of relief.
examples.zh: 歷經數個月排山倒海般的緊繃高壓摧殘，她在一切塵埃落定後終於忍不住如釋重負痛哭。

examples.en: The outdoor picnic was called off due to the typhoon warning.
examples.zh: 由於發布了颱風警報，戶外野餐活動宣告取消。

examples.en: The umpire decided to call off the baseball game when lightning illuminated the outfield.
examples.zh: 當刺目的閃電照亮外野夜空時，主審裁判果斷裁定立刻取消中止本場棒球賽事。

examples.en: Due to widespread transit strikes abroad, the music band had to call off three European tour dates.
examples.zh: 由於海外多國爆發大規模公共交通罷工潮，該樂團不得不痛心取消三場歐洲巡迴演唱。

examples.en: Let's grab coffee this Saturday and catch up with each other!
examples.zh: 這週六我們一起喝杯咖啡敘敘舊吧！

examples.en: He sprinted with all his might across the station platform to catch up with his departing friends.
examples.zh: 他在車站月台上使出渾身解數奮力衝刺，終於趕上並追上了正準備啟程遠行的好友群。

examples.en: She studied three extra hours every evening to catch up with her classmates in chemistry.
examples.zh: 為了追趕上同班同學在化學實驗進度上的領先優勢，她每晚特意多挑燈夜戰三個小時。

examples.en: Read English news daily to keep up with current global affairs.
examples.zh: 每天閱讀英語新聞以跟上全球時事脈動。

examples.en: Jogging beside an experienced marathon runner is tough if you can't keep up with the pace.
examples.zh: 與資深馬拉松老將並肩晨跑頗具難度，如果你的體能完全跟不上對方的配速節奏的話。

examples.en: It takes continuous dedication for tech professionals to keep up with rapidly evolving AI tools.
examples.zh: 科技從業人員唯有日日保持求知若渴的學習熱忱，方能跟得上日新月異的 AI 工具浪潮。

examples.en: Hold on a second; I'll transfer your call to the service department.
examples.zh: 請稍候片刻，我馬上幫您轉接至客服部門。

examples.en: Hold on tight to the handrail while the subway train negotiates high-speed curves.
examples.zh: 當捷運列車在高速通過急轉彎路段時，請務必雙手緊緊握牢車廂內的防護扶手。

examples.en: The coach shouted encouragement from the sidelines, urging exhausted players to hold on.
examples.zh: 總教練在場邊大聲吶喊鼓勁，聲嘶力竭地激勵已逼近體能極限的球員咬牙堅持挺住。

examples.en: Big sister looked after her younger brother while parents worked.
examples.zh: 父母上班時，姊姊在家細心照顧年幼的弟弟。

examples.en: Can you look after my pet beagle for three days while I attend a conference in Taichung?
examples.zh: 我下週要去台中參加一場三天兩夜的學術研討會，你能幫忙照料一下我的米格魯愛犬嗎？

examples.en: Dedicated nurses work around the clock to look after newborn infants in the hospital nursery.
examples.zh: 愛心滿滿的專業護理人員日夜輪班值勤，在嬰兒室內無微不至地看顧剛出生的新生兒。

examples.en: The police officer promised to look into the neighborhood theft.
examples.zh: 警員承諾將深入調查社區失竊案件。

examples.en: Our engineering team will immediately look into the database performance slowdown.
examples.zh: 我們的核心軟體工程團隊將第一時間深入排查，徹查資料庫運行效能驟降的箇中原委。

examples.en: Before investing your hard-earned savings, thoroughly look into the company's financial background.
examples.zh: 在把你辛辛苦苦積攢的血汗錢投入股市之前，務必事先徹底調查該公司的財務體質與背景。

examples.en: Young athletes look up to world-class Olympic medalists.
examples.zh: 年輕運動員們十分敬仰世界級的奧運得獎選手。

examples.en: Throughout my entire schooling, I have always looked up to my high school physics teacher.
examples.zh: 在我求學生涯的各個階段中，我內心深處始終無比敬仰我高中的物理啟蒙老師。

examples.en: Children naturally look up to their parents and mirror how they handle everyday conflicts.
examples.zh: 孩子們生來便會自然而然地仰望效仿父母，並潛移默化地模仿長輩處理日常矛盾的方式。

examples.en: Never look down on anyone because of their background or job.
examples.zh: 絕不要因為他人的出身或職業而輕視任何人。

examples.en: A truly confident person never feels the arrogant need to look down on others.
examples.zh: 一個內心真正充盈強大且具備高度自信的人，絕不會自命不凡、心存輕慢地瞧不起別人。

examples.en: He was raised with humble values teaching him not to look down on simple, honest labor.
examples.zh: 他自幼深受質樸善良的家風薰陶，懂得凡是以汗水自食其力的誠實勞動皆神聖不可輕慢。

examples.en: He studied extra hard on weekends to make up for missed classes.
examples.zh: 他週末格外用功讀書以彌補之前缺課拉下的進度。

examples.en: No amount of money can truly make up for lost time away from your growing children.
examples.zh: 再多的金錢財富，都永遠無法真正彌補錯過陪伴年幼子女成長歷程的珍貴時光。

examples.en: The restaurant served complimentary handmade desserts to make up for the kitchen's slow service.
examples.zh: 為彌補廚房備餐上菜稍有延誤的疏失，餐廳主管主動奉上由甜點師現作的招待手作糕點。

examples.en: Does this English grammar explanation make sense to you?
examples.zh: 這段英文文法解說你聽得懂、覺得合理明白嗎？

examples.en: It makes complete economic sense to insulate your home attic before winter arrives.
examples.zh: 在冷冽冬季正式到來之前，為自家庭院閣樓加裝隔熱保溫層，在經濟效益上完全合理划算。

examples.en: His surprising career change didn't make much sense to his colleagues at first glance.
examples.zh: 他突然毅然跨界轉換職業跑道的驚人舉動，乍看之下讓身旁的同事同儕感到有些匪夷所思。

examples.en: Pay close attention to traffic lights when crossing the avenue.
examples.zh: 過馬路時請密切注意交通號誌。

examples.en: Students should pay undivided attention to the teacher during science laboratory demonstrations.
examples.zh: 自然科學實驗課進行操作示範時，全體同班同學應當心無旁騖、高度專注於老師的每一步驟。

examples.en: Pay attention to sudden weather alerts broadcasted on radio stations during mountain hikes.
examples.zh: 高山健行登山途中，務必隨時留心收聽廣播中播送的任何突發性區域極端天候警報。

examples.en: I can't put up with the loud construction noise next door anymore.
examples.zh: 我再也無法忍受隔壁吵雜刺耳的施工噪音了。

examples.en: Commuters on morning subway trains patiently put up with cramped, crowded train cars.
examples.zh: 早晨尖峰時段搭乘捷運的通勤上班族，每日都耐著性子默默容忍車廂內的擁擠與狹窄。

examples.en: A professional customer support agent learns how to put up with frustrated, rude callers.
examples.zh: 一位合格成熟的專業客服人員，懂得如何在面對情緒失控且口氣不善的來電時保持克制。

examples.en: Let's set up a study group to prepare for the TOEIC exam.
examples.zh: 我們來組建一個讀書會一起準備多益測驗吧。

examples.en: The camping enthusiasts quickly set up their waterproof tents before nightfall.
examples.zh: 經驗老到的露營愛好者趕在夜幕完全低垂之前，乾淨俐落地搭好了各自的防風抗水帳篷。

examples.en: It takes only a few simple steps to set up two-factor authentication on your smartphone.
examples.zh: 只要跟隨螢幕指引操作幾個簡單設定步驟，就能在智慧手機上成功啟用雙重身分驗證。

examples.en: Her fluent spoken English made her stand out during the interview.
examples.zh: 她流利的英語口說讓她在面試中脫穎而出。

examples.en: The bright yellow raincoat stood out vividly against the misty, gray mountain fog.
examples.zh: 那件亮黃色的連帽雨衣，在一片白茫茫的灰濛深山雲霧中顯得格外的搶眼與醒目。

examples.en: Having diverse internship experience helps your job application resume stand out among applicants.
examples.zh: 擁有豐富多元且含金量高的實習經歷，能讓你的求職履歷在數百位競爭者中顯得出類拔萃。

examples.en: Hundreds of students took part in the annual campus charity run.
examples.zh: 數百名學生熱情參與了一年一度的校園慈善路跑。

examples.en: Would you like to take part in the citywide English speech contest next month?
examples.zh: 你有意願報名參加下個月即將在全市隆重登場的英語即席演講錦標賽嗎？

examples.en: Citizens are warmly encouraged to take part in open town hall discussions on public parks.
examples.zh: 市政當局極力鼓勵廣大市民朋友熱情走出家門，主動參與公共綠地公園規劃的公民論壇。

examples.en: Take full advantage of library resources to improve your vocabulary.
examples.zh: 充分利用圖書館資源來擴充你的英文單字量。

examples.en: Tourists should take advantage of the convenient Day Pass to tour Taipei on the MRT.
examples.zh: 造訪台北的觀光旅客應當好好善用便捷超值的一日通票，搭乘綿密的捷運暢遊各大景點。

examples.en: Be vigilant so unscrupulous vendors do not take unfair advantage of your kindness.
examples.zh: 出門在外請隨時保持警覺，切莫讓少數居心不良的無良商販有機可乘、佔了你善良的便宜。

examples.en: The difficult test turned out to be much easier than expected.
examples.zh: 那場原本看似艱難的考試結果比預期簡單許多。

examples.en: Don't worry prematurely; things often turn out much better than our worst fears.
examples.zh: 切勿杞人憂天過早焦慮；事情最終發展的結果，往往遠比我們心中最壞的設想好上許多。

examples.en: Thousands of cheerful music fans turned out for the outdoor summer jazz concert.
examples.zh: 數千名熱愛音樂的樂迷粉絲如潮水般熱情湧現到場，熱烈參與了這場夏日露天爵士音樂會。

examples.en: Watch out for slippery wet floors after the sudden afternoon downpour.
examples.zh: 午後陣雨過後請特別當心地面濕滑。

examples.en: Hikers along rocky mountain trails must watch out for venomous snakes and falling stones.
examples.zh: 攀爬穿梭於崇山峻嶺亂石步道間的登山客，務必時刻提高警惕提防毒蛇出沒與高空落石。

examples.en: Always watch out for speeding scooters when opening car doors on busy city streets.
examples.zh: 在車水馬龍的市區街道旁開啟汽車車門下車時，切記「兩段式開門」並當心後方機車。

examples.en: As a matter of fact, I have lived in Tainan for over five years.
examples.zh: 事實上，我已經在台南居住了超過五年。

examples.en: I know him quite well; as a matter of fact, we were high school classmates.
examples.zh: 我和他彼此熟絡得很；事實上，我們在高中時代曾經同班同窗了整整三年。

examples.en: She didn't find the calculus test difficult; as a matter of fact, she scored one hundred!
examples.zh: 她一點都不覺得剛才那張微積分考卷很難；事實上，她竟然直接拿下了整整一百分的滿分！

examples.en: I ran into an elementary school friend at the bookstore by accident.
examples.zh: 我在書店偶然巧遇了一位國小同學。

examples.en: Penicillin was discovered entirely by accident when mold contaminated a petri dish.
examples.zh: 青黴素（盤尼西林）的驚世問世，純粹是一次實驗培養皿意外遭黴菌汙染所促成的巧合。

examples.en: He deleted the draft document by accident, but luckily retrieved it from trash.
examples.zh: 他在整理資料夾時不小心失手誤刪了那份企劃初稿，所幸及時從資源回收筒中完整找回。

examples.en: He didn't drop the cup on purpose; it just slipped from his hand.
examples.zh: 他不是故意摔壞杯子的；只是手滑不小心掉了。

examples.en: Did you hide my car keys on purpose, or did you honestly just misplace them?
examples.zh: 你到底是故意把我的汽車鑰匙藏起來惡作劇，還是真的自己隨手放忘記收在哪裡了？

examples.en: She arrived thirty minutes early on purpose to secure front-row seats for the seminar.
examples.zh: 為了能在萬人空巷的熱門大師講座中搶佔第一排黃金視野寶座，她特意提早半小時抵達。

examples.en: In general, public transport in Taiwan is clean, punctual, and safe.
examples.zh: 一般而言，台灣的大眾運輸乾淨、準時且十分安全。

examples.en: In general, younger students acquire foreign accents faster than adult learners.
examples.zh: 總體而言，年幼的兒童學童在模仿吸收外語地道發音時的速度，普遍快於成年學習者。

examples.en: The food was delicious and the service was warm; in general, it was a wonderful dinner.
examples.zh: 菜餚精緻可口且侍者服務親切周到；總括來說，這是一場無比愉悅且賓主盡歡的美好晚宴。

examples.en: I love Taiwanese night markets, in particular the crispy fried chicken.
examples.zh: 我非常喜愛台灣夜市，特別是香脆多汁的鹽酥雞。

examples.en: The professor praised the entire project team, in particular the lead software architect.
examples.zh: 指導教授對全體專案小組成員給予了高度肯定，特別對主導開發的核心架構師讚譽有加。

examples.en: Is there any destination in particular that you would like to visit in eastern Taiwan?
examples.zh: 這次規劃造訪東台灣的深度慢活之旅中，是否有任何特別想去走走看看的私房景點嗎？

examples.en: Book high-speed train tickets in advance during holiday seasons.
examples.zh: 連假期間請務必事先提前預訂高鐵車票。

examples.en: Please inform the hotel staff in advance if you have any severe food allergies.
examples.zh: 如果您本人對特定海鮮或堅果有任何嚴重的食物過敏史，請務必於入住用餐前事先告知。

examples.en: Paying your utility bills in advance ensures you never suffer unnecessary late fees.
examples.zh: 事先預繳或設定銀行帳戶自動扣繳水電瓦斯公用事業規費，能確保你絕不會產生逾期滯納金。

examples.en: Please return to your seats at once; the bell is ringing.
examples.zh: 請立刻回到座位上，上課鐘聲響了。

examples.en: When the alarm sounded, all office employees evacuated the high-rise building at once.
examples.zh: 當大樓火警警報驟然響起的那一刻，全體辦公同仁立刻井然有序地從高層大廈全員疏散。

examples.en: Don't try to master all seven thousand vocabulary words at once; learn forty every day.
examples.zh: 千萬不要好高騖遠妄想著一口氣把七千個單字在一天之內背完；每天按部就班背四十個即可。

examples.en: We go hiking in the countryside once in a while.
examples.zh: 我們偶爾會去鄉村郊外健行踏青。

examples.en: She eats healthy salads every day, but enjoys a chocolate doughnut once in a while.
examples.zh: 她平日三餐都嚴格自律地享用低卡有機沙拉，但偶爾也會放縱自己吃上一顆香甜巧克力甜甜圈。

examples.en: Once in a while, it does you good to disconnect from digital screens and enjoy nature.
examples.zh: 偶爾讓自己完全遠離發光的數位螢幕、放下手機，走進大自然中深呼吸，對身心大有裨益。

examples.en: All of a sudden, heavy raindrops started tapping on the window.
examples.zh: 突然之間，豆大的雨滴開始敲打著窗戶。

examples.en: We were cycling peacefully along the river when all of a sudden a stray dog dashed across.
examples.zh: 我們正優哉游哉地沿著河濱微風騎行時，突然之間一隻小野狗冷不防從草叢中橫穿飛奔而出。

examples.en: The classroom fell into dead silence when all of a sudden the principal walked into the room.
examples.zh: 當校長出乎所有人意料突然邁步走進教室大門的那一刻，原本喧鬧的教室瞬間鴉雀無聲。

examples.en: Follow the recipe step by step to bake delicious pineapple cakes.
examples.zh: 按照食譜步驟一步步操作，就能烤出美味的鳳梨酥。

examples.en: Mastering a foreign language requires daily effort taken patiently step by step.
examples.zh: 想要真正精通一門外國語言，唯有日復一日、沉著冷靜地循序漸進方能水到渠成。

examples.en: The tutor explained the complex physics calculation step by step on the whiteboard.
examples.zh: 課輔家教在白板上條理清晰、一步一步地詳細拆解推導了那道高難度的高中物理計算題。

examples.en: How is your new semester going? — So far, so good!
examples.zh: 你的新學期過得如何？— 到目前為止一切都很順利！

examples.en: We have completed half of the marathon course and, so far so good, my knees feel fine.
examples.zh: 我們已經成功跑完了整場全馬賽程的一半路程，到目前為止一切安好，雙膝沒有絲毫不適。

examples.en: The software launch entered its third testing phase; so far so good, with zero bugs reported.
examples.zh: 這款大型軟體上線已順利進入第三測試驗收階段；到目前為止一切順遂，未接獲任何錯誤。

examples.en: Practicing listening day after day leads to true fluency.
examples.zh: 日復一日堅持練習聽力能帶來真正的流利度。

examples.en: Day after day, the dedicated baker kneads fresh sourdough loaves with pride.
examples.zh: 日復一日，這位充滿職人敬業精神的烘焙師總是自豪滿滿地親手揉捏新鮮天然酸種麵糰。

examples.en: She showed up at the swimming pool day after day until she perfected her butterfly stroke.
examples.zh: 她日復一日風雨無阻地準時出現在市立游泳池苦練，直到徹底把蝶式泳姿雕琢到完美無瑕。

examples.en: Sooner or later, hard work and dedication will pay off.
examples.zh: 辛勤努力與全心投入遲早會帶來回報。

examples.en: If you neglect routine car maintenance, sooner or later an expensive breakdown will happen.
examples.zh: 如果你平日總是輕忽例行的汽車機油與剎車保養，車子遲早會發生耗費不貲的嚴重拋錨。

examples.en: Sooner or later, truth will emerge and clarify all unfounded neighborhood rumors.
examples.zh: 遲早事實的真相必定會大白於天下，徹底澄清巷弄街坊間流傳的一切捕風捉影無稽之談。

examples.en: You are holding the map upside down!
examples.zh: 你把地圖拿反了（上下顛倒）啦！

examples.en: The sudden international move turned their quiet family routine upside down for months.
examples.zh: 這次突如其來的跨國搬遷外派調動，將他們原本安居樂業的家庭日常節奏徹底攪了個天翻地覆。

examples.en: Hang the freshly gathered herb bunches upside down in a dry cupboard to cure them.
examples.zh: 將剛採摘下來的翠綠新鮮香草束頭朝下倒掛在乾燥通風的櫥櫃之中，使其自然風乾脫水。

examples.en: The hikers arrived home safe and sound after the typhoon passed.
examples.zh: 颱風過後，登山客們已平安無事、安然無恙返抵家中。

examples.en: Despite flight delays and stormy winds, all travelers landed safe and sound at Taoyuan Airport.
examples.zh: 儘管航程中遭遇了嚴重的氣流顛簸與班機延誤，所有旅客最終皆安然無恙平安降落桃園機場。

examples.en: We breathed a huge sigh of relief once the lost mountain rescue dog returned safe and sound.
examples.zh: 當那隻在搜救任務中失聯走散的高山搜救犬平安無事地自行返回營地時，所有人如釋重負。

examples.en: Could you please give me a hand moving this wooden desk?
examples.zh: 能請你幫我一把，一起搬動這張木書桌嗎？

examples.en: Kind commuters gave the tourist a hand carrying her heavy baby stroller up the subway stairs.
examples.zh: 熱心善良的捷運通勤乘客紛紛主動伸出援手，合力幫忙帶著大包小包的遊客抬嬰兒車爬樓梯。

examples.en: Whenever classmates struggled with math homework, David was always willing to give them a hand.
examples.zh: 每當班上同學在面對艱澀高深的高中數學作業陷入苦戰時，大衛總是無比熱心伸出援手。

examples.en: Keep in mind that practice makes perfect in language learning.
examples.zh: 請牢記：熟能生巧是語言學習的不二法門。

examples.en: Keep in mind that museum galleries are strictly closed for cleaning on Mondays.
examples.zh: 請大家務必牢記於心：全市各大市立美術館與歷史博物館每逢週一皆固定休館進行大掃除。

examples.en: While drafting your speech, keep in mind the diverse interests and age of your audience.
examples.zh: 在撰寫你的公眾演講稿時，請時時刻刻將現場台下觀眾跨年齡層的多元興趣銘記於心。

examples.en: She made up her mind to study computer science in college.
examples.zh: 她下定決心大學要攻讀資訊工程學系。

examples.en: He wavered for hours over the restaurant menu before finally making up his mind.
examples.zh: 他拿著豐富多元的餐館菜單猶豫不決反覆琢磨了良久，最後才終於下定決心點了招牌菜。

examples.en: Once you make up your mind to pursue a lifelong dream, pursue it with all your heart.
examples.zh: 一旦你真正下定決心去追逐自己一生的崇高志向，就請毫無保留、全心全意地勇敢奔赴。

examples.en: That minor rumor has nothing to do with the actual facts.
examples.zh: 那個微不足道的小謠言與實際事實毫無關聯。

examples.en: The cancellation of the flight had nothing to do with equipment error; it was purely due to fog.
examples.zh: 本次航班被迫取消與飛機機械故障沒有任何關係，純粹是因為機場跑道被特大濃霧所籠罩。

examples.en: Mind your own daily responsibilities and stay out of petty gossip that has nothing to do with you.
examples.zh: 專心做好自己手頭的本分工作，切莫去插手攪和那些與你本人八竿子打不著的無聊八卦。

examples.en: Congratulations on completing the first 2,000 essential English words!
examples.zh: 恭喜您順利完成了前 2,000 個核心基礎英語單字！

examples.en: Heartfelt congratulations to the newlyweds on building a beautiful life together!
examples.zh: 向這對共結連理、攜手打造溫馨美好家庭的新婚夫婦致以最誠摯的由衷祝賀！

examples.en: Send a warm card expressing congratulations to your friend who just passed the bar exam.
examples.zh: 寄出一張精緻溫暖的祝賀卡片，向剛剛金榜題名通過國家律師高考的摯友表達熱烈祝賀。
